arxiv-2109-02025.title: Revisit prompt J / ψ J/\psi production in associated with Higgs Boson via gluon fusion at the LHC
arxiv-2109-02025.creator: Xue-An Pan 1, Zhong-Ming Niu 1, Gang Li 1, Yu Zhang 2,1, Mao Song 1, Jian-You Guo 1
arxiv-2109-02025.description: Abstract The production of charmonium associated with Higgs boson via gluon fusion has been investigated in Ref. Kniehl:2002wd , in which they considered the contribution of final Higgs boson radiation off the charm quark at tree level and found that this process is to be far too rare to be observable in any of the considered experiments.

arxiv-2304-10469.title: Direct laser acceleration in underdense plasmas with multi-PW lasers: a path to high-charge, GeV-class electron bunches
arxiv-2304-10469.creator: R. Babjak, L. Willingale, A. Arefiev, M. Vranic
arxiv-2304-10469.description: Abstract The direct laser acceleration (DLA) of electrons in underdense plasmas can provide 100s of nC of electrons accelerated to near-GeV energies using currently available lasers. Here we demonstrate the key role of electron transverse displacement in the acceleration and use it to analytically predict the expected maximum electron energies.

arxiv-2305-02856.title: Stereological determination of particle size distributions for similar convex bodies
arxiv-2305-02856.creator: Thomas van der Jagt, Geurt Jongbloed, Martina Vittorietti
arxiv-2305-02856.description: Abstract Consider an opaque medium which contains 3D particles. All particles are convex bodies of the same shape, but they vary in size. The particles are randomly positioned and oriented within the medium and cannot be observed directly. Taking a planar section of the medium we obtain a sample of observed 2D section profile areas of the intersected particles.

arxiv-2305-13982.title: Toward stochastic neural computing
arxiv-2305-13982.creator: Yang Qi
arxiv-2305-13982.description: Abstract Abstract The highly irregular spiking activity of cortical neurons and behavioral variability suggest that the brain could operate in a fundamentally probabilistic way. Mimicking how the brain implements and learns probabilistic computation could be a key to developing machine intelligence that can think more like humans.

arxiv-2404-14282.title: Blockchain in a box: A portable blockchain network implementation on Raspberry Pi’s
arxiv-2404-14282.creator: Matija Piškorec, Anton Ivashkevich, Said Haji Abukar, Lundrim Azemi, Md Rezuanul Haque, Mostafa Chegenizadeh, Claudio J. Tessone {}^{~}
arxiv-2404-14282.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matija Piškorec, Anton Ivashkevich, Said Haji Abukar, Lundrim Azemi, Md Rezuanul Haque, Mostafa Chegenizadeh, Claudio J. Tessone {}^{~}. In this paper we describe a prototype of a blockchain-in-a-box system which allows users to easily bootstrap the whole Ethereum Proof-of-Work (PoW) network running on multiple Raspberry Pi nodes - an inexpensive modular computers.

arxiv-2508-03746.title: Spectral extremal problem of the p p th power of cycles
arxiv-2508-03746.creator: Xinhui Duan, Lu Lu
arxiv-2508-03746.description: Abstract For a cycle C k C_{k} on k k vertices, its p p -th power, denoted C k p C_{k}^{p} , is the graph obtained by adding edges between all pairs of vertices at distance at most p p in C k C_{k} .

arxiv-2512-00016.title: Architect in the Loop Agentic Hardware Design and Verification
arxiv-2512-00016.creator: Mubarek Mohammed
arxiv-2512-00016.description: Abstract The ever increasing complexity of the hardware design process demands improved hardware design and verification methodologies. With the advent of generative AI various attempts have been made to automate parts of the design and verification process. Large language models (LLMs) as well as specialized models generate hdl and testbenches for small components, having a few leaf level components.

arxiv-2602-16288.title: Is the Standard Model Effective Field Theory Enough for Higgs Pair Production?
arxiv-2602-16288.creator: Íñigo Asiáin, Ramona Gröber, Lorenzo Tiberi
arxiv-2602-16288.description: Abstract We study Higgs-boson pair production in the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) up to dimension six and in the Higgs Effective Field Theory (HEFT) at leading order in the effective theory expansion, and assess which description is appropriate in concrete UV scenarios.

pmc-10656938.creator: Wei-Ming Yu, Guo-Wei Li, Ming-Geng Lou, Zheng-Yu Wu
pmc-10656938.description: IntroductionTo date, an increasing number of studies have revealed that GP73 may have prognostic value in liver cancer. However, most of the studies evaluated serum GP73, and the results regarding the prognostic value of tGP73 in liver cancer are still controversial. Therefore, in this meta-analysis, we aimed to determine whether tGP73 has any prognostic value in patients with HCC.

pmc-11346528.title: The anticancer mechanisms of Toxoplasma gondii rhoptry protein 16 on lung adenocarcinoma cells
pmc-11346528.creator: Guangqi Li, Qinhui Li, Yongqing Tong, Jin Zeng, Tiantian Dang, Ningai Yang, Yuning Zhou, Lei Ma, Qirui Ge, Zhijun Zhao
pmc-11346528.description: Lung adenocarcinoma is the most prevalent subtype of lung cancer, which is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Toxoplasma gondii (T.gondii) Rhoptry protein 16 (ROP16) has been shown to quickly enter the nucleus, and through activate host cell signaling pathways by phosphorylation STAT3 and may affect the survival of tumor cells.

pmc-11430739.title: Inverse Correlation of Th2-Specific Cytokines with Hepatic Egg Burden in S. mansoni-Infected Hamsters
pmc-11430739.creator: Lena Russ, Verena von Bülow, Sarah Wrobel, Frederik Stettler, Gabriele Schramm, Franco H. Falcone, Christoph G. Grevelding, Martin Roderfeld, Elke Roeb
pmc-11430739.description: Schistosomiasis, a parasitic disease caused by Schistosoma spp., affects more than 250 million people worldwide. S. mansoni in particular affects the gastrointestinal tract and, through its eggs, induces a Th2 immune response leading to granuloma formation. The relationship between egg load and immune response is poorly understood.

pmc-11497435.title: Severe mpox in an immunocompromised patient complicated by deep tissue infection: A case report
pmc-11497435.creator: Susanne Pfefferle, Michaela Schweizer, Kristin Hartmann, Julia Berger, Dominik Nörz, Petra Emmerich, Ronald von Possel, Katja Giersch, Lisa Sophie Pflüger, Christian Bernreuther, Markus Glatzel, Susanne Krasemann, Thomas Theo Brehm, Julian Schulze zur Wisch, Nicole Fischer, Stefan Schmiedel, Martin
pmc-11497435.description: ObjectivesWe report prolonged mpox (>14 weeks) in a patient with HIV complicated by deep tissue MPXV infection despite two courses of tecovirimat treatment.MethodsMPXV-DNA levels in lesional swabs, blood and tissue were quantified by qPCR. Anti-MPXV antibodies were analyzed by IF and VNT. Infectivity was assessed by virus isolation.

pmc-12419089.title: Chromium picolinate alleviates heat stress-induced breast muscle glucose and lipid metabolism disorders in broiler chickens
pmc-12419089.creator: Miao Yu, Xiumei Li, Xin Zhao, Jinghai Feng, Minhong Zhang
pmc-12419089.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). To date, extensive research has shown that heat stress disturbs glucose and lipid metabolism in broiler chickens. Recent evidence suggests that chromium supplementation influences metabolic regulation, particularly in glucose and lipid homeostasis in mammals. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of chromium picolinate supplementation on glucose and lipid metabolism in the breast muscle of broiler chickens under chronic heat stress.

pmc-12507221.title: Targeted vaccination is effective for mpox clade Ib in England despite increased household transmission: Predictions from a modelling study
pmc-12507221.creator: Ellen Brooks-Pollock, Leon Danon, Max Carlos Ramírez-Soto, Max Carlos Ramírez-Soto
pmc-12507221.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Mpox is an emerging infectious disease with increasing global relevance. In 2024, a new clade, mpox clade Ib, was associated with high household attack rates and case fatality, raising concerns about sustained human-to-human transmission outside endemic areas. We developed and applied an individual-based probabilistic framework for mpox incorporating sexual and household contact patterns using data from the National Survey of Sexual Attitudes and Lifestyles 3 (NATSAL3). Individual and population-level reproduction numbers were estimated using setting-specific secondary attack rates.

pmc-12664616.title: A Blueprint for Building a Renal Denervation Program
pmc-12664616.creator: Tayyab Shah, Catherine Vanchiere, Maria Bonanni, Debbie L Cohen, Jay Giri, Taisei Kobayashi, Brian Fulton
pmc-12664616.description: Renal denervation (RDN) has emerged as a promising adjunctive therapy for hypertension, particularly in patients with poor blood pressure control despite pharmacologic and lifestyle interventions. With the recent approval of 2 RDN systems by the US Food and Drug Administration, there is growing opportunity for interested interventional cardiologists to develop expertise in this rapidly evolving, unsaturated field.

pmc-13506560.creator: Janni Mølsted, Anne Birgitte Als, Jørgen Bjerggaard Jensen, Mikael Aagaard, Jakob Kristian Jakobsen
pmc-13506560.description: PurposeTo present the characteristics of Danish penile cancer patients, treatment strategies, and prognosis.MethodsThe Danish National Penile Cancer database currently contains information on 1,397 patients with penile cancer referred to a university center from 2000 to 2025. The database was established by retrospective medical chart review. The set of variables were defined by the Danish Multidisciplinary Cancer Group, DaPeCa.

pmc-13628712.title: Enhancing tumor T cell antigen prediction by integrating deep protein representations
pmc-13628712.creator: Umut Oskay, Baris Tudes, Emre Sefer
pmc-13628712.description: BackgroundCancer is a major threat to human health, and cancer immunotherapy is considered the most promising treatment option. It offers high effectiveness and precision, with fewer side effects than traditional treatments. Tumor T cell antigens (TTCA) are the proteins or protein fragments that stand on the surface of cancer cells and that are recognized by the immune system.

pmc-13671071.title: Early disruptions in brain capillary blood flow control in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-13671071.creator: Ashwini Hariharan, Abigail Vigderman, Dominic P. Isaacs, Nick Weir, Gyubyung Park, Serena Edwards, Thomas A. Longden
pmc-13671071.description: Hariharan et al. show that in a mouse model of Alzheimer’s disease, capillary blood flow control fails early: endothelial Kir2.1 currents decline at 2–4 mo, followed by pericyte KATP channel impairment by 6–8 mo. Notably, the early Kir2.1 deficit can be rescued by restoring PIP2 levels, which reinstates communication between deep capillary pericytes and upstream arterioles.
